data.one_liner: Provides ISO 3166-1 country codes in an enum-like class with parsing and user-assigned elements.
data.what_it_does: Provides a list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3, and numeric country codes inside an enum-like class. It allows parsing country codes from strings and supports user-assigned code elements.
use_when: You need to validate or parse ISO 3166-1 country codes in your Dart or Flutter application.
You require access to alpha-2, alpha-3, and numeric country representations.
avoid_when: You need complete localized country names and translations for UI displays.
You require complex geo-location or timezone mapping utilities.
strengths: Supports ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3, and numeric codes
Includes parsing capabilities and user-assigned code elements
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic country code parsing and listing
Does not document built-in UI pickers or full country names
